scripts.build:resources: npm run build --workspace @bluink/fonts && npm run build --workspace @bluink/typst
scripts.build: npm run build:resources && npm run build:native && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.contracts:check: cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked contracts::generated_contracts_match_rust_and_wire_examples -- --exact && tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2023 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --skipLibCheck backend/contracts/generated/wire.ts backend/contracts/contract.test-d.ts
scripts.format: biome format --config-path backend --write scripts && npm run format --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: biome lint --config-path backend scripts && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run type-check --workspace backend && npm run contracts:check
scripts.test: node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml --locked
